purpose: Two review-only proposal images; not connected to frontend
inspiration_summary: Original 2026 ChatGPT examples inform preserving a character's identity when adapting clothing to its body, and giving the character a meaningful place-specific action. All final prompts below were newly written for these project images.

kyoto.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square 1:1 review proposal, a premium tactile wool-felt handcrafted travel snapshot, concept "destination-exclusive travel companion".
Series art direction: the ENTIRE frame is one coherent handcrafted wool-felt and stitched-textile stop-motion world. A highly recognizable version of the provided mascot travels inside a miniature interpretation of the provided destination photo. The character, scenery, clothing and props share wool-felt materials, physical scale, soft natural lighting, real ground contact, cast shadows and occlusion. Fine felt fibers and tiny crafted seams, restrained premium editorial finish, tactile nostalgia, clear storytelling. Photo provides the PLACE layout, not photographic pixels pasted behind a wool toy.
Fixed camera and composition across both destination tests: square canvas, a single 50mm-equivalent lens at the protagonist's eye level, gentle three-quarter frontal view, full character visible in the middle foreground occupying approximately 40% of canvas width, shallow but moderate depth of field so landmark shapes remain legible. Same character scale and crafted material treatment in both tests. Full continuous scenic frame, no split layout, collage, cutout, studio background, display base, packaging, snow globe or corner badge.
Mascot identity invariant: use Image 1 as the only character identity. A plump soft YELLOW rounded triangular body points unmistakably to the RIGHT; its left/back edge has a tall rounded CYAN vertical panel. Exactly two large upright WHITE OVAL applique eyes with small dark pupils retain the same upper-left face placement and proportions as the reference, the left eye partly across the cyan/yellow boundary and the right eye on the yellow face. Keep the broad yellow triangle and both eyes conspicuous, retain cyan panel visible. No mouth, nose, human face, animal face or invented humanoid head. Outfit must be adapted to this triangular body rather than turning it into a human. Tiny soft mitten arms and two short felt feet are allowed only to perform the place-specific action; they stay small and secondary.
Negative constraints: no people, human silhouettes, other character cameos, romance, words, typography, letter logos, captions, watermark, flat pasted logo or floating company-brand overlay. No giant limbs. One premium stop-motion travel moment with a real purposeful action.
Input images: Image 1 is the official chicTrip mascot reference. Image 2 is the Kyoto shrine travel photo, used for recognizable layout and actual location details only. Remove all visitors and written signs from the destination interpretation.
Destination scene: preserve the quiet shrine entrance: a weathered BLACK/DARK WOODEN torii with a low straight top crossbeam, thick braided shimenawa rope with straw tassels and white zigzag shide beneath it, small wooden shrine roofs beyond, a stone-edged pale gravel entrance path, a dense green broadleaf canopy and natural trunks above. The torii is the readable principal place anchor behind the mascot, fully within frame; no invented red gate, fantastical temple or romance. Build the torii from dark wood-textured felt and the rope from real miniature braid, leaves from layered sage and moss felt.
Outfit and action: the yellow triangular traveler wears a subtle forest-sage miniature haori robe adapted around only its lower third, with a tiny cream sash. It has one small cloth omamori pouch tied at its side, unlettered with a simple stitched pattern. Capture a SMALL respectful bow at the shrine entrance: its triangular body inclines forward only about ten degrees, its little mittens quietly placed together below the face and feet firmly touching the gravel. Keep both white eyes and the yellow face clearly visible in the gentle three-quarter frontal view. The point still aims right, cyan back panel stays visible; costume never becomes a new head or hides mascot identity.
Lighting and mood: calm dappled daylight through a lush canopy, gentle forest-sage, dark wood, warm gravel and ivory braid surrounding the clean signature yellow/cyan traveler. Match the series eye-level camera and 40% character size. A quiet respectful travel snapshot, not a staged product figurine photo.

references.role: user destination photograph; actual place layout and details only

Change its location, clothing and action for this new USJ scene.

A spacious curving park path lies in the foreground under a soft blue sky with wool clouds. Keep the tiered hills, green pipes and gray castle legible as an actual theme-park place. Remove all photographed visitors, written signs, watermarks and park character cameos; keep the recognizable landscape structure. The hills, castle, path and pipes are physically crafted felt/textile miniatures sharing the character's light and materials, not a literal photo background.

Retain the unmistakable large yellow triangle face, its cyan vertical left/back panel and the same large white oval eyes as the official reference and Kyoto companion.
Capture an excited park-planning moment: little feet planted on the park path, its small mitten hands holding a tiny unfolded PAPER-FABRIC PARK MAP in front of the lower body, pupils looking toward the map and head tilted a few degrees with lively curiosity; one mitten lightly indicates a route. The map has only clean abstract colored path shapes and small icon dots, no letters, words or numbered text. ONE small gold coin/star cloth charm hangs discreetly from an overall strap, physically attached, with no letter or printed symbol. Only these two place-related accessories.
Lighting and mood: cheerful clear daylight, moderated premium colors with signature yellow/cyan traveler, red cap, denim blue overalls, grass green, warm tan block tiers and cool gray castle. Keep the exact series 40%-width character size and eye-level 50mm view from Image 3. Emphasize one spontaneous stop-motion travel snapshot with tactile clothing, contact shadows and softly legible park surroundings.
